name: Fontana Unified School District
districtFact: Fontana Unified School District publishes board-approved school calendar PDFs with first day and last day dates, weekly minimum days, elementary and middle school conference minimum days, end-of-semester minimum days, high school final exam minimum days, Fall Break, Winter Break, Spring Break, holidays, professional development days, member directed days, and Spanish calendar PDFs.

about.title: About Fontana Unified School District
about.content: Fontana Unified School District serves students and families in Fontana and nearby San Bernardino County communities in the Inland Empire. The district school calendar is the main planning source for first day and last day dates, Labor Day, Veterans Day, Fall Break, Winter Break, Spring Break, Memorial Day, Juneteenth, professional development days, member directed days, weekly minimum days, conference minimum days, and high school finals schedules.

about.title: How to Use This Fontana Unified Calendar
about.content: Use this page for districtwide Fontana Unified school calendar dates, then confirm campus-specific events, bell schedules, testing, athletics, graduation details, emergency closures, and same-day announcements through Fontana Unified or your student's school.

customSections.label: Fontana Unified Local Calendar Context
customSections.content: Fontana Unified calendar planning is important for Inland Empire families because the district calendar includes weekly minimum days, conference minimum days, high school final exam minimum days, and non-student professional development or member directed days. Families should review both the main school calendar PDF and school-site notices before arranging childcare, transportation, travel, appointments, or after-school activities.

planningTips.title: Fontana Unified Calendar Usage Tips
content: Use the official school year calendar PDF for districtwide first day, last day, breaks, holidays, and non-student days.
Plan around weekly Wednesday minimum days because they can affect dismissal routines throughout the year.
Check elementary and middle school conference weeks separately because those dates are listed as minimum days.
Use the Spanish calendar PDF when helpful, but verify that the dates match the English board-approved calendar.

links.label: Parent Planning Guide
links.description: See childcare, travel, minimum-day, and finals planning notes for the 2026-2027 Fontana Unified calendar.

comparisonTitle: Fontana Unified Calendar Comparison With Nearby Districts
compareIntro: Use this nearby-district reference to compare Fontana Unified with other Inland Empire school calendars currently available on MySchoolDates. Dates shown include the first day, last day, and spring break. Some districts publish multiple calendar tracks or program calendars; comparison rows use the reviewed calendar version available from each district source and should be verified before making cross-district plans.

districtFaqs.q: Does Fontana Unified publish Spanish school calendars?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. Fontana Unified publishes Spanish school year calendar PDFs for the 2025-2026, 2026-2027, and 2027-2028 calendars reviewed here.

districtFaqs.q: Where should families verify Fontana Unified calendar updates?
districtFaqs.a: Use the official Fontana Unified school year calendars page and campus announcements for final confirmation. MySchoolDates is an independent reference and is not affiliated with Fontana Unified School District.
